title: Pulls paint of when removing
text: Pulls paint of when removing. The hand itself is a strong sturdy piece; just be sure not to remove item once placed onto anything that come off with it when removing. Would purchase again. I remove the rubberish sticker & use ticky-tac in its place so can remove from wall without paint coming off with it.
